items.title: 68429_Walter P. Thomas oral history interview
items.q: The interviewee (Walter P. Thomas) only responds with 'Oh yeah' and 'Yeah, he was great' to the interviewer's detailed narrative about Jimmy Blanton's illness and death. There is no evidence in the transcript that Thomas personally knew, met, or collaborated with Blanton; the interaction is primaril

ctx.x: Yeah... We played the Cotton Club, you know.
No, this wasn't the Cotton Club. I'm thinking about in the Thirties and early Forties. And Duke Ellington's band had just left there, and the very fabulous Jimmy Blanton had gotten sick.
